# INV-EMPTY for C001, with no lines and not posted.
#
# GnuCash saves an invoice nobody has added a line to yet, and so does
# `import`: nothing is destroyed by creating one. Read again, the block still
# states no line and the book still holds none, so there is nothing to lose.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C001 and an unposted invoice with no
# lines.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_invoice_with_no_lines_read_again_is_unchanged.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-EMPTY"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	posted: none
	payment: none
